functions.name: getBigInt64
functions.summary: Gets the BigInt64 value at the specified byte offset from the start of the view. There is no alignment constraint; multi-byte values may be fetched from any offset.

params.name: byteOffset
params.description: The place in the buffer at which the value should be retrieved.

params.name: littleEndian
params.description: If false or undefined, a big-endian value should be read.
